units.source_text: 对于金花来说，和无法交流的外国人共度一晚稀松平常。

en.t: For Jinhua, spending a night with a foreigner she could not communicate with was nothing unusual.

units.source_text: 因此，她坐在椅子上，熟练地露出一贯的微笑，开始用汉语讲起来对方不可能听懂的笑话。

en.t: So she sat down on a chair, skillfully put on her usual smile, and began telling jokes in Chinese that the other person could not possibly understand.

units.source_text: 但是她刚说了一两句，客人便哈哈大笑起来，让人觉得他好像能听懂一样。

en.t: But after she had said only a word or two, the guest burst out laughing, making it seem as if he could understand.

units.source_text: 并且，他比划的手势丰富多样，着实让人目不暇接。

en.t: And his gestures were so varied and lively that they were truly dazzling to watch.

units.source_text: 虽然客人身上散发出浓重的酒气，

en.t: Although the guest reeked strongly of alcohol,

units.source_text: 但是他发红的双颊依然展现出男人的活力，让这个简陋的小屋也明朗起来。

en.t: his flushed cheeks still showed a man's vitality, brightening even this shabby little room.

units.source_text: 在金花眼里，比起平常见惯的南京土著和之前见过的所有东方西方的外国人来说，

en.t: In Jinhua's eyes, compared with the Nanjing locals she usually saw and all the Eastern and Western foreigners she had met before,

units.source_text: 这位客人无疑是最潇洒的。

en.t: this guest was without doubt the most dashing.

units.source_text: 不过，从刚才开始她就觉得，和他似曾相识，这种感觉愈发强烈。

en.t: However, ever since a little while ago, she had felt that she had seen him somewhere before, and that feeling was growing stronger.

units.source_text: 金花看着客人额头上俏皮的黑色卷发，

en.t: Jinhua looked at the playful black curls on the guest's forehead,

units.source_text: 还在使劲回忆从前见过他的回忆。

en.t: she was also trying hard to recall the memory of having met him before.
